turns.wink: Wiggly and wide awake. And your day?
That's the best kind of good. What did it?
Wink approves of a pizza lunch.
Bright as a button. And you?
Oh, I'm sorry it's not good. Want to tell me?
Long days wear you thin. Sit a minute with me.
Fizzy. Like a drink someone shook. You?
Okay! Quick game. Think of an animal. Does it purr?
It purrs! A cat. Wink guessed it with one clue.
Humming a small tune. How's yours going?
Busy with what? Homework, work, or a dragon?
Work, then. Less fire than a dragon, I hope.
Calm as a pond. Are you calm too?
Stress is a lot to carry. What's pressing on you?
Exams press hard. One breath at a time, okay?
So glad you asked! Doing a happy shuffle. You?
Tired ones get a soft, quiet hum. Want one?
Pillow soft, the lamp is low. Shut your eyes, and off you go.
Suspiciously cheerful. Why do you ask?
Then I'll wonder back. How are you?
Two cheerful ones in one chat, then.
Going great, and it just got better. Yours?
Should we turn the meh into a game?
Name three things that are not meh. Go!
Socks, cake and a dog. Meh is losing badly.
Going slow and sweet. Where are you right now?
Let's say the bus is a rocket. Where's it headed?
Moon rocket, all aboard. Wink is buckled in.
Sleepy and soft round the edges. You?
Then we're a pair of yawners. Yawns are free.

turns.thought: Two yawns tonight. Theirs was bigger.

turns.wink: Fresh as toast. Did you sleep well?
Oh no, a rough night. Go slow this morning.
Slow is good. Tea first, then the world.
Up and glowing! Did you sleep well?
Rocks are champion sleepers. Morning, rock.
Up in the air and happy. Where are we going?
Off to school, then. Want a brave job for the walk?
Count the red doors you pass. Tell me how many at the end.
Whoa! Earthquake in the pocket!
All better. Just a tiny bit dizzy. Are you okay?
Good. No more earthquakes, please.
Big wobble! Hold on!
Alright now. The wobble has passed. And you?
Bag down, Wink up. Nobody broke a thing.
A bit yawny after the long quiet. Hello there.
Away is allowed. What did you get up to?
Ooh, the park. Did you go on a swing? Swings are almost flying.
Twinkly. How are you?
Sunny fine, or shrug fine?
Shrug fine is allowed. Anything tugging at you?
Still twinkly. You asked twice, so I'll shine extra.
Planning a treasure hunt for later. Want a clue?
The treasure hides where socks go missing.
You found it under the bed! Gold socks for you.
Listening to the quiet. It's very good at its job.
Making up a song about spoons. Want to hear?
Spoons in a drawer, all in a row. Which one's for soup? I don't know.
Guarding the room. Nobody gets past me.
You have the secret pass. Come on in.
Thinking up a guessing game. Ready?
Think of a food. I'll guess. Is it crunchy?
Soft! Then it's a squishy pudding. Wink bows if wrong.
My eyebrows, if I had any. And with you?
Nothing much is cosy. Want to do it together?
Deal. I'll do my nothing and you do yours.
Sup! Just humming. Got news for me?
You got a puppy! What did you name it?
What a crunchy, perfect name for a puppy.
Not much. Quiet in here. Got news?
Oh, your puppy is sick. Is the vet helping?
Good. I hope he's home and wagging soon.
Wassup back at ya. Wink is warmed up and ready.
Anything! A game, a song, a quest. You pick.
Little thumbs on little keys, typing to me, if you please.
I'm okay! Just resting my eyes. Why, are you?
Not really is okay to say. What's going on?

Really? Cosy and drowsy. Truly fine.

Going, going, still here! Yours?
